checks: Durable FIFO follows source Wake insertion order even when notifications arrive in reverse order.
Explicit Owner pause/resume records a new scope/epoch authorization, preserves queue age and leaves the original Wake receipt immutable.
An old resume receipt cannot authorize a later unrelated epoch change.
Stop/reopen cannot revive an unscanned old Wake; a new message has an atomic control watermark and remains admissible.
Owner resume cannot silently adopt changed permissions, role definition or account configuration.
Resource, budget, Run, Attempt and dispatch insertion faults atomically roll back the entire claim while retaining one waiting Invocation.
A persistently budget-blocked candidate does not churn eligible flags or emit self-sustaining availability events.
Nested queue writes emit only committed durable events after the outer transaction; rollback emits none.
Effect callbacks recheck source-Thread ACL snapshots after claim, even when the destination Binding remains authorized.
A budget-blocked same-slot Wake retains its age and precedes a later waiting source after Owner budget resume.
Recovery idempotently projects a durable control terminal after prior quiescence without executing or reclaiming its Wake.
scope: T06 deterministic queue and injected fake-runtime SQLite fixtures; no production database, network or real model
